transcript.answer: Before any memory or episode is stored, Lore runs the content through its privacy filter, `sanitizeContent()` / `redactSecrets()`. This filter strips API keys, JWTs, private keys, connection strings and bearer tokens. It applies to all memory writes: episodes and memories, through both the MCP tool and REST API paths. Tests also cover GitHub `ghp_` tokens. The spec says the redaction happens before the value is stored, embedded or sent to fact extraction.
